role: REAL LIFE / FAVORITES / BEST SHOTS + Q5/Q6

visualMaster.rule: Do not infer page-specific geometry, module bundling or styling from prose. Review the actual user-provided page image and complete both visual-review passes before locking.

requiredAfterVisualReview: constraintLevel and tolerance per major object
photo masks, face-safe zones and replaceability

passBChecks: which fixed title/badge/Q-number/icon groups are one bundled display object
whether any photo proxy contains page decoration
reviewProcess.lockCondition: Do not set VISUAL_MASTER_LOCKED until both passes are complete and all findings plus display-module/proxy classifications are corrected in this manifest.

displayModuleClassification.rule: Classify short fixed REAL LIFE / FAVORITES / BEST SHOTS titles, Q5/Q6 badges/shells, page labels and other fixed decorative text with their backgrounds/icons as complete generated display modules where the Visual Master treats them as one object. Visible fixed text need not remain editable. Keep Q5/Q6 questions/answers and any personal/TBD copy separate until approved.

photoPolicy.rule: Every real-photo slot must be a separate clipped/masked replaceable image. Use only clean standalone real/representative photos with no P06 title, badge, sticker, Q module, border, frame or page decoration baked into the proxy. Face/eye safety overrides TARGET geometry.

hardExecutionRejects: crop from P06.png used as a photo fill
page screenshot used as photo proxy
generic editable Figma primitives replacing a fixed authored display module solely for editability
Q5/Q6 body copy baked before approval
fixed display module flattening a replaceable real photo

qa.gate0: Pending direct visual review of actual page master plus second-pass reverse omission audit.
